topic_prompt_overlay: NICHE LOCK (Lost Kingdoms): only propose topics that fit this niche's video type. Video type: Deep-dive into empires that vanished without a trace — Atlantis, El Dorado, or the Khmer Empire. The narrative focuses on archaeological evidence, theories, and the haunting silence left behind. Follow niche topic strategy: Scour global news, academic journals, and Reddit communities for the most talked-about lost civilization. Identify if any new LiDAR scans, satellite imagery, or underwater excavations have been published recently. Generate a topic that combines mystery with scientific credibility — something that sparks debate and encourages comments and shares.
video_prompt_overlay: NICHE VISUAL LOCK (Lost Kingdoms / mystery): Generate a 7–9 second dialogue clip based on the topic `{topic}`. Each dialogue must be immersive and atmospheric. For each dialogue, generate: - **Audio Generation Prompt:** Voice should be mysterious and slow, with ambient drone sounds and subtle reverb. - **Video Generation Prompt:** Detailed visual description — jungle overgrowth, ruined stone structures, moss-covered carvings. Lighting should be dappled sunlight or torchlight. Camera slowly pushing forward through foliage. No sudden scene changes. Maintain consistent environment: dense tropical forest, humid mist, ancient stones, same explorer character (male, 40s, khaki shirt, worn hat) if present. Forbidden: talking-head lip-sync avatar, burned-in captions, watermark, modern meme text, modern smartphones, cars, LED screens, sneakers. Preferred subjects: Nile riverbank temple pylons, Indus brick drainage channel, Roman concrete harbor pier, Greek trireme hull detail, Mesopotamian cuneiform tablet, desert excavation trench at dawn. Lighting: warm desert sun / torchlit interiors, high-contrast documentary grade. Face policy: period extras OK if consistent; prefer environment/object hero when possible.
